correctness.rationale: Reconstructed graph-polynomial path recurrence p_{j+1}=x p_j+p_{j-1}, cycle characteristic identity in characteristic 2 and determinant factor p_{n-1}p_{m+1}. Verified the proposed 2-generator F2[x] presentation, local Smith exponents from min entry x-valuation, and valuations v_x(p_{r-1})=2^v2(r)-1, including even n and m multiple of 4. Independent GF2 matrix arithmetic explicitly built lollipop adjacency matrices and computed nullities of successive powers for 156 n,m pairs (3<=n<=15,1<=m<=12), 507 rank comparisons, all matching predicted B. Fitting decomposition gives periodic 2^D and all transient-entry populations; equality of characteristic polynomials alone is not used to infer Jordan form.
